notes.title: New updates coming soon :).
notes.content:
I'm developing new levels to the game, this way, when the new updates are released, you will be able to play two games mode.[list]
[*] The first one is the classic mode, you will can play the default version of the game.
[*] The second one is the adventure mode, you will can play differents levels that will be separated into chapters. The first chapter, that will be released, will have 21 levels and the last one is for the boss. This mode you won't  need to collect all coins to pass the level.
[/list]

notes.title: Thank you for playing In Dungeon
notes.content:
Since the release of the game [b]In Dungeon[/b], I have been hard working to improving it, but I thanks the players, who send their criticisms and suggestions for improvements. Many of the problems found in the game have been fixed and suggestions have been implemented, this way, [b]In Dungeon[/b] has become better and more fun, gradually I'm adding new features for that players have more fun.

Thank you very much for everyone

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020168/a9867ed8f37b05f737fbb004126b25c60a09b580.png[/img]

notes.title: In Dungeon 1.0.4.0 - Released
notes.content:
[b]Release Notes:[/b]

In this new version you will receive rewards for each level that you beat.
The rewards are:
[list]
    [*] Bonus points and gold: These rewards are default on any level of difficulty, however, the values ​​will depend on the level of difficulty chosen and the number of stars earned.
    [*] Time bonus: You receive this reward only if the "Time, Time" option is enabled when a new game is chosen.
    [*] Points for each available health: The values ​​will depend on the level of difficulty chosen.
   [*] Bonus for ammunition of weapons: Each weapon will receive a different quantity of ammunition, however, the quantity will depend on the level of difficulty chosen, the higher the level of difficulty, the higher will be the amount of ammunition. If the options "Time, Time", "Penumbra", "The Risk", "The Mythic" or Detonation are enabled you will too receive an extra quantity.
Note: Weapons rewards has a maximum quantity to receive.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020168/0e7e5d6d1e1fa70bf7e16c63f851c62635058043.png[/img]

notes.title: In Dungeon 1.0.3.0 - Released
notes.content:
Release Notes:

[list]
    [*]Added the option "Detonation" when the New game is choose, this way, you can add more difficulties in the game. In last version, the enemies exploded by default, now you should enabled if you want it.
    [*]Stones that are similar the spikes were removed.
    [*]The dialogue of the  prisoners was improved. Now some prisoners can give tips about game.
[/list]

[list]
[*]The physics of character was changed to improve the gameplay.

[*]Fixed minor bugs.
[/list]
